title: Executive Functionning Study for Assessing the Effect of Neurofeedback
description: This dataset comprises EEG recordings from 24 participants performing three executive functioning tasks (N-Back, Sustained Attention to Response Task, and Local Global) collected during the first and last sessions of a neurofeedback intervention study. The dataset includes preprocessed EEG data with standardized referencing and downsampling, along with source data in original BioSemi format, providing a resource for investigating executive function and neurofeedback effects on cognitive performance.
methods_description: EEG data were collected during three cognitive tasks: N-Back (working memory, 1-3 back conditions), Sustained Attention to Response Task (sustained attention, 250 digit presentations), and Local Global (selective attention, congruent/incongruent letter stimuli). Data were acquired at 2048 Hz, downsampled to 256 Hz, high-pass filtered at 1 Hz using an elliptical filter, and average referenced. Two sessions were conducted on the first and last days of the neurofeedback experiment.
